linear.RegressionSummary.name: RegressionSummary
linear.RegressionSummary.label: Regression Summary
linear.RegressionSummary.description: NewRegressionSummary composes the supplied cumulative slope and residual SNR. Each intermediate is calculated once. The raw candidates remain visible even when their domain fails; published slope/SNR use the original zero plus false convention. No ridge or stable centered-update algorithm is substituted.

temporal.Velocity.name: Velocity
temporal.Velocity.label: Velocity
temporal.Velocity.description: NewVelocity evaluates source and clock once per input. The first observation and non-advancing time have zero rate with explicit definedness. The latest point is always retained, including when its clock does not advance.

equation.Polarize.name: Polarize
equation.Polarize.label: Polarize
equation.Polarize.description: NewPolarize splits a signed value into nonnegative components and normalizes against a configured scale expression. The result preserves all components.

equation.ShedMoments.name: ShedMoments
equation.ShedMoments.label: Shed Moments
equation.ShedMoments.description: NewShedMoments applies the source's support-shedding domain, without changing its mean or sample dispersion. Non-contraction requests leave the record unchanged. The policy chooses when; this composition defines what shedding is.

causal.Features.name: Features
causal.Features.label: Features
causal.Features.description: NewFeatures requires the treatment to be represented, and excludes the outcome from the predictors. Positional shape validation belongs to Gather/At.

probability.Ambiguity.name: Ambiguity
probability.Ambiguity.label: Ambiguity
probability.Ambiguity.description: NewAmbiguity divides entropy by the entropy of an equal-mass distribution. A one-member distribution has zero ambiguity by definition.

algo.OLS.name: OLS
algo.OLS.label: OLS
algo.OLS.description: NewOLS composes ordinary least squares via the supplied source's normal equations, with partial-pivot Gauss-Jordan solving replacing its LU backend. Input is {x: [][]float64, y: []float64}; callers include an intercept column explicitly. n<=p and rank deficiency yield defined=false, empty coefficients, and NaN residual variance. There is no ridge or invented rank tolerance. The configured tolerance expression is forwarded to the linear solver.

hawkes.Branching.name: Branching
hawkes.Branching.label: Branching
hawkes.Branching.description: NewBranching composes the source's offspring and stationary-mean formulas. alpha's column names identify the parent side. Supercritical parameters still report their radius/first generation; stationary means and total descendants are marked undefined rather than emitting non-stationary expectations.

equation.Prominence.name: Prominence
equation.Prominence.label: Prominence
equation.Prominence.description: NewProminence composes neighbouring profile readings. x coordinates determine units; LagProfile supplies seconds, so curvature uses inverse squared seconds. Edge peaks have no neighbours and report ErrShape rather than old evidence.

matrix.Scale.name: Scale
matrix.Scale.label: Scale
matrix.Scale.description: NewScale evaluates both configured operands once per observation.

data.Quality.name: Quality
data.Quality.label: Quality
data.Quality.description: NewQuality derives fresh maturity/SNR facts from optional estimator fields. The source Finalize precedence is preserved, including requiring support>1 before Mahalanobis overrides scalar SNR. This composition receives the facts record itself; external measurement serialization is a separate boundary.

linear.Determinant2.name: Determinant2
linear.Determinant2.label: Determinant2
linear.Determinant2.description: NewDeterminant2 composes ad-bc for the four entries of a 2-by-2 matrix.

store.First.name: First
store.First.label: First
store.First.description: NewFirst configures the value held before anything has been shown.

store.Second.name: Second
store.Second.label: Second
store.Second.description: NewSecond configures the value held before anything has been shown.

equation.Bound.name: Bound
equation.Bound.label: Bound
equation.Bound.description: NewBound captures the value and both bounds once before selecting. Bounds may be computations; neither their result nor the value is recomputed during selection. NaN passes through unchanged rather than becoming a bound.

equation.Ratio.name: Ratio
equation.Ratio.label: Ratio
equation.Ratio.description: NewRatio binds two expressions to one captured input run. Both operands are computations, not decoded values; the source is consumed only once.

equation.Spacings.name: Spacings
equation.Spacings.label: Spacings
equation.Spacings.description: NewSpacings subtracts integer nanosecond timestamps before conversion to float. An empty or one-observation run has no adjacent pair and emits no spacing.

adaptive.Envelope.name: Envelope
adaptive.Envelope.label: Envelope
adaptive.Envelope.description: NewEnvelope uses the supplied moment and width expressions. Choice of a Gaussian or Chebyshev coefficient is topology, not an EnvelopeType switch.

hawkes.Intensity.name: Intensity
hawkes.Intensity.label: Intensity
hawkes.Intensity.description: NewIntensity evaluates one side's pre-event intensity and beta derivative. Side selection is routing between parameter records; support and arithmetic are shared compositions. Input uses flat natural parameter names and events.

equation.Count.name: Count
equation.Count.label: Count
equation.Count.description: NewCount is addition over unit contributions. It counts delivered objects, regardless of their payload type. Collection members must first be Spread.

matrix.Diagonal.name: Diagonal
matrix.Diagonal.label: Diagonal
matrix.Diagonal.description: NewDiagonal selects row i's member i. An undersized row is a shape error.

joint.Estimator.name: Estimator
joint.Estimator.label: Estimator
joint.Estimator.description: NewEstimator applies one configured moment estimator per coordinate. Input is a values []float64 record, already in log space. Other facts such as at remain in the output. Estimators is a source of actual Primitive endpoints; their count, rather than a hard-coded vector width, establishes the shape. The joint SNR is the source's diagonal standardized-energy mean, not a full inverse-covariance Mahalanobis estimate. Each endpoint owns its own history.

learning.RatioTarget.name: RatioTarget
learning.RatioTarget.label: Ratio Target
learning.RatioTarget.description: NewRatioTarget is the relative change, with an explicit nonzero past domain.

equation.IntervalOverlap.name: IntervalOverlap
equation.IntervalOverlap.label: Interval Overlap
equation.IntervalOverlap.description: NewIntervalOverlap is (left.from < right.to) AND (right.from < left.to). Endpoints touching at a single instant do not overlap for (from,to] spans.

correlation.Correlation.name: Correlation
correlation.Correlation.label: Correlation
correlation.Correlation.description: NewCorrelation composes covariance / sqrt(left energy * right energy). It preserves finite-sample asynchronous values outside [-1,1]. Empty or zero-energy normalization is undefined, not zero or a previous result.

adaptive.Threshold.name: Threshold
adaptive.Threshold.label: Threshold
adaptive.Threshold.description: NewThreshold composes a moment estimator with a dispersion coefficient. Coefficient selection is a configured graph, not a ThresholdType switch.

equation.SamplingVariance.name: SamplingVariance
equation.SamplingVariance.label: Sampling Variance
equation.SamplingVariance.description: NewSamplingVariance retains the record-based connection for Primitive composition.

equation.Sigmoid.name: Sigmoid
equation.Sigmoid.label: Sigmoid
equation.Sigmoid.description: NewSigmoid is a composition, including mapping over multiple inputs.

hawkes.Gradient.name: Gradient
hawkes.Gradient.label: Gradient
hawkes.Gradient.description: NewGradient adds natural-parameter derivatives to a NewLikelihood result. The output gradient order is mu_x,mu_y,alpha_xx,alpha_xy,alpha_yx,alpha_yy,beta.

transport.MapReduce.name: MapReduce
transport.MapReduce.label: Map Reduce
transport.MapReduce.description: NewMapReduce composes the existing map and pipe transports. It contains no second scheduler, reduction implementation, queue, or callback protocol.

store.Each.name: Each
store.Each.label: Each
store.Each.description: NewEach configures the run being routed and the operation every value of it is stepped through.

adaptive.Path.name: Path
adaptive.Path.label: Path
adaptive.Path.description: NewPath composes timestamp acceptance with adaptive observation retention. The configured window determines retained support from changes in the observed values. No wall-clock expiry or fixed history length is imposed. Regressed observations never reach the policy; restatements are accepted observations.

learning.DirectionalTarget.name: DirectionalTarget
learning.DirectionalTarget.label: Directional Target
learning.DirectionalTarget.description: NewDirectionalTarget composes a finite nonnegative deadband and sign of a delta. deadband is evaluated on the input record. To use a separately updated store as read-only configuration, pass transport.NewApply(retained, nil).

temporal.Decay.name: Decay
temporal.Decay.label: Decay
temporal.Decay.description: NewDecay wires input -> clock -> shape, multiplying the original input by the resulting retention factor. No clock means infinite elapsed time; the default linear shape therefore extinguishes a finite input. Configuration is not evaluated by construction, and each slot can be an arbitrary composition.

logic.Finite.name: Finite
logic.Finite.label: Finite
logic.Finite.description: NewFinite is not-NaN and not-infinite, assembled from existing predicates.

equation.Standardize.name: Standardize
equation.Standardize.label: Standardize
equation.Standardize.description: NewStandardize composes (value - center) / scale. State and the choice of causal center/scale are supplied in the incoming record, not owned here.

algo.Welford.name: Welford
algo.Welford.label: Welford
algo.Welford.description: NewWelford wires Welford's running-moment recurrence through one retained KV. Optional record-to-record policies may transform support after an update, before variance is derived. With no policy this is cumulative Welford. Prior fields always describe the moments before the current observation.

inputs.name: policies
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

learning.DeltaTarget.name: DeltaTarget
learning.DeltaTarget.label: Delta Target
learning.DeltaTarget.description: NewDeltaTarget returns the observed current-minus-past difference.

equation.Minimum.name: Minimum
equation.Minimum.label: Minimum
equation.Minimum.description: NewMinimum binds both expressions to one captured input. The calculus fold owns the comparison and IEEE behavior; no finite sentinel substitutes for infinity.

correlation.FisherEstimator.name: FisherEstimator
correlation.FisherEstimator.label: Fisher Estimator
correlation.FisherEstimator.description: NewFisherEstimator transforms admissible scalar correlations before the configured causal estimator, then maps its baseline back with Tanh. Invalid observations do not advance the estimator and are visibly undefined. The configured estimator supplies recurrence; this composer keeps no second copy.

matrix.Difference.name: Difference
matrix.Difference.label: Difference
matrix.Difference.description: NewDifference evaluates each matrix expression once per observation.

hawkes.Likelihood.name: Likelihood
hawkes.Likelihood.label: Likelihood
hawkes.Likelihood.description: NewLikelihood is the bivariate exponential Hawkes log likelihood, given natural parameters, events, origin and horizon. It preserves strict origin exclusion, equal-time grouping semantics and pre-origin kernel history. Invalid parameters are explicit errors. No stationary fit, optimization, significance calibration or parameter-bound selection is claimed here.

collection.Swap.name: Swap
collection.Swap.label: Swap
collection.Swap.description: NewSwap is two indexed replacements over one captured collection. It adds no second swapping kernel; both original operands survive the first write.

equation.All.name: All
equation.All.label: All
equation.All.description: NewAll combines predicates over the same captured input. Every predicate is evaluated; the empty conjunction is true.

inputs.name: predicates
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

equation.Fisher.name: Fisher
equation.Fisher.label: Fisher
equation.Fisher.description: NewFisher composes the Fisher-z normal-tail formula for records containing "correlation" and "support". This formula does not establish calibration for dependent asynchronous overlaps. Invalid domains propagate NaN/Inf normally.

matrix.Identity.name: Identity
matrix.Identity.label: Identity
matrix.Identity.description: NewIdentity enumerates the dimension once, without a scalar graph per coefficient.

vector.Dot.name: Dot
vector.Dot.label: Dot
vector.Dot.description: NewDot pairs two scalar streams, multiplies each pair and adds the products. Zip owns the shape check; no vector-specific arithmetic loop exists.

equation.CausalResidual.name: CausalResidual
equation.CausalResidual.label: Causal Residual
equation.CausalResidual.description: NewCausalResidual measures against the moments that existed before the observation. Its configured estimator owns recurrence and any forgetting. The source's zero-dispersion convention is explicit: use |residual| as the score scale, or zero when the residual is zero. Both the prior variance and the actual score scale are exposed, rather than conflated.

equation.GeometricMean.name: GeometricMean
equation.GeometricMean.label: Geometric Mean
equation.GeometricMean.description: NewGeometricMean composes exp(mean(log(x))). Zero and invalid-domain behavior comes from those operations; no alternate product or hand-written loop exists.

adaptive.Baseline.name: Baseline
adaptive.Baseline.label: Baseline
adaptive.Baseline.description: NewBaseline configures one independent causal baseline and window.

causal.LinearPrediction.name: LinearPrediction
causal.LinearPrediction.label: Linear Prediction
causal.LinearPrediction.description: NewLinearPrediction evaluates one row against a configured-by-record affine fit. Input fields: fit (OLS output record), features, row. It does not train.

hawkes.Compensator.name: Compensator
hawkes.Compensator.label: Compensator
hawkes.Compensator.description: NewCompensator integrates both intensities across the observed window.

learning.Forecast.name: Forecast
learning.Forecast.label: Forecast
learning.Forecast.description: NewForecast composes the supplied multiplicative forecast-scale learner. Welford owns the residual moments. Storage owns trust/scale; Mix supplies both recurrences. The current residual participates in its source-defined surprise statistic; this is not mislabeled as a strictly prior standardized residual.

collection.Gather.name: Gather
collection.Gather.label: Gather
collection.Gather.description: NewGather selects positions supplied by an index-stream expression. At owns index validation; retention owns the captured collection and current index.

equation.Curvature.name: Curvature
equation.Curvature.label: Curvature
equation.Curvature.description: NewCurvature composes neighbouring profile readings. x coordinates determine units; LagProfile supplies seconds, so curvature uses inverse squared seconds. Edge peaks have no neighbours and report ErrShape rather than old evidence.

equation.ExtremeScale.name: ExtremeScale
equation.ExtremeScale.label: Extreme Scale
equation.ExtremeScale.description: NewExtremeScale evaluates sqrt(2*log(count)), the coefficient used by the supplied EVT and Gaussian envelope modes. It adds no tail calibration claim.

adaptive.Window.name: Window
adaptive.Window.label: Window
adaptive.Window.description: NewWindow creates an independent policy with the two-sample variance minimum.

causal.LinearFit.name: LinearFit
causal.LinearFit.label: Linear Fit
causal.LinearFit.description: NewLinearFit composes the supplied table's affine design into ordinary least squares. Input fields are rows, target (float64 index), features ([]float64 indices). The caller declares the exact feature list; no automatic removal, addition, ordering or deduplication of predictors occurs here.

probability.Distribution.name: Distribution
probability.Distribution.label: Distribution
probability.Distribution.description: NewDistribution composes a simplex and its named readouts. There is no second Collection interface and no accessors that bypass Primitive delivery.

learning.SampleRatio.name: SampleRatio
learning.SampleRatio.label: Sample Ratio
learning.SampleRatio.description: NewSampleRatio preserves the supplied calibration ratio and observed-range ceiling. Those are model policies, not statistical identities. They are explicit compositions over the shared residual-span update.

equation.WeightedMean.name: WeightedMean
equation.WeightedMean.label: Weighted Mean
equation.WeightedMean.description: NewWeightedMean consumes KV-shaped records with "weight" and "value" keys.

vector.Finite.name: Finite
vector.Finite.label: Finite
vector.Finite.description: NewFinite asks whether every scalar in the incoming run is finite.

hawkes.CompensatorDerivative.name: CompensatorDerivative
hawkes.CompensatorDerivative.label: Compensator Derivative
hawkes.CompensatorDerivative.description: NewCompensatorDerivative includes the derivative of both the kernel numerator and the 1/beta scale. Omitting either changes the fitted model.

hawkes.LogGradient.name: LogGradient
hawkes.LogGradient.label: Log Gradient
hawkes.LogGradient.description: NewLogGradient applies the source's chain rule for log(mu), log(beta), and log branching coordinates. Beta changes alpha=branch*beta as well as decay.

hawkes.Support.name: Support
hawkes.Support.label: Support
hawkes.Support.description: NewSupport reduces a configured response over events strictly before horizon on the selected side. Equal-time events do not excite one another. The whole retained history may precede origin; origin is not a support cutoff.

temporal.Governor.name: Governor
temporal.Governor.label: Governor
temporal.Governor.description: NewGovernor composes an observation-driven capacity, retained tail and reduction. The controller yields a record containing capacity (float64). Neither the store nor reduction knows which policy selected the capacity.

inputs.name: stages
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

equation.LagProfile.name: LagProfile
equation.LagProfile.label: Lag Profile
equation.LagProfile.description: NewLagProfile evaluates the configured estimator at every lag over the same decoded paths. Spacing is nanoseconds; span counts steps on either side. Every candidate retains the complete estimator record and its own support. Index identity is retained before conversion to seconds, so boundary indices cannot be corrupted by floating-point round trips.

equation.ResidualSpan.name: ResidualSpan
equation.ResidualSpan.label: Residual Span
equation.ResidualSpan.description: NewResidualSpan reproduces the supplied calibration range update. Its count stays at one until the first distinct residual, then counts every update. It is therefore the source's state counter, not a count of observations.

adaptive.Gating.name: Gating
adaptive.Gating.label: Gating
adaptive.Gating.description: NewGating suppresses values inside a configured threshold of inclusive moments. Estimation, threshold calculation and Boolean routing stay separate.

vector.Difference.name: Difference
vector.Difference.label: Difference
vector.Difference.description: NewDifference subtracts paired members and collects one output vector.

store.Spread.name: Spread
store.Spread.label: Spread
store.Spread.description: NewSpread configures the Primitive whose run is handed over. It is not drained here: a Primitive is whole before it is advanced, and the run is taken when a caller begins one.

correlation.Cohort.name: Cohort
correlation.Cohort.label: Cohort
correlation.Cohort.description: NewCohort summarizes one peer run of {correlation,support,peer_energy?} records. Support below two and nonfinite correlations are excluded, with counts exposed. The caller supplies the dispersion transform (normally Atanh). It is applied once per admitted peer. No clamp is hidden in this composition: an undefined transform makes fisher_defined false rather than fabricating finite evidence. A new delivery run is a new cohort; no Reset method or replay convention exists.

correlation.Dependence.name: Dependence
correlation.Dependence.label: Dependence
correlation.Dependence.description: NewDependence preserves the configured estimator and adds support, path duration, energy-rate and definedness diagnostics. The estimator executes once per pair. Finite-sample correlation remains unclipped; zero-energy estimates are undefined.

adaptive.Clock.name: Clock
adaptive.Clock.label: Clock
adaptive.Clock.description: NewClock normalizes |value| by the estimator's inclusive mean and applies its configured pace. Volume time is obtained by placing Absolute before this graph; signed interarrival behavior does not require a ClockType switch.

algo.HayashiYoshida.name: HayashiYoshida
algo.HayashiYoshida.label: Hayashi Yoshida
algo.HayashiYoshida.description: NewHayashiYoshida computes asynchronous covariance from {left,right} observation collections. Each return contributes once to its own energy and to every strictly overlapping cross-product. Support counts overlaps, not independent samples. The existing correlation primitive owns energy normalization, without clipping.

store.Record.name: Record
store.Record.label: Record
store.Record.description: NewRecord composes field-producing expressions into KV. It introduces no record type and contains no arithmetic or observation interpretation.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

equation.AdaptiveZScore.name: AdaptiveZScore
equation.AdaptiveZScore.label: Adaptive Z Score
equation.AdaptiveZScore.description: NewAdaptiveZScore uses log-space moments. The configured estimator determines whether its horizon is cumulative or adaptive. Non-positive logarithms keep the underlying real-domain result; they are not replaced by log(1).

equation.Correlation.name: Correlation
equation.Correlation.label: Correlation
equation.Correlation.description: NewCorrelation composes covariance / sqrt(left energy * right energy). It preserves finite-sample asynchronous values outside [-1,1]. Empty or zero-energy normalization is undefined, not zero or a previous result.

equation.CumulativeSum.name: CumulativeSum
equation.CumulativeSum.label: Cumulative Sum
equation.CumulativeSum.description: NewCumulativeSum is Add with explicit feedback through retention. The Add itself remains unchanged and can still be used as a per-run reduction.

equation.Median.name: Median
equation.Median.label: Median
equation.Median.description: NewMedian averages the two central order statistics. Any NaN makes the result undefined; infinities remain ordered values. Empty runs report a shape error.

equation.SecondDifference.name: SecondDifference
equation.SecondDifference.label: Second Difference
equation.SecondDifference.description: NewSecondDifference composes 2*center-left-right. Choice of magnitude versus signed value, and spacing normalization, are supplied by the surrounding graph.

equation.Any.name: Any
equation.Any.label: Any
equation.Any.description: NewAny combines predicates over the same captured input. The empty disjunction is false.

inputs.name: predicates
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

equation.Design.name: Design
equation.Design.label: Design
equation.Design.description: NewDesign selects configured feature positions and prepends the affine intercept. Its output is a design vector; it does not fit or predict.

equation.EnergyRates.name: EnergyRates
equation.EnergyRates.label: Energy Rates
equation.EnergyRates.description: NewEnergyRates composes r² / elapsed seconds over interval records.

equation.SearchScale.name: SearchScale
equation.SearchScale.label: Search Scale
equation.SearchScale.description: NewSearchScale composes sqrt(2*log(candidates)/observations), preserving the source lead/lag threshold formula. This expression alone does not establish a calibrated test for asynchronously overlapping, dependent returns.

equation.Softmax.name: Softmax
equation.Softmax.label: Softmax
equation.Softmax.description: NewSoftmax captures the maximum, shifts each logit, exponentiates, normalizes. Non-finite logits fail explicitly rather than producing plausible certainty.

correlation.Fisher.name: Fisher
correlation.Fisher.label: Fisher
correlation.Fisher.description: NewFisher reports the Fisher-z normal approximation for {correlation,support}. Optional search_count supplies Bonferroni multiplication. A finite-sample HY overlap count is NOT thereby made an independent sample size. The caller owns that statistical assumption. Undefined inputs yield defined=false and NaN, never a stale p-value. At +/-1 the extended-real limit yields p=0, not p=1.

correlation.LagShape.name: LagShape
correlation.LagShape.label: Lag Shape
correlation.LagShape.description: NewLagShape reads the neighbours of the explicitly selected index. It does not search for a different maximum (zero lag may exceed the nonzero winner). Undefined or out-of-range neighbours yield shape_defined=false, never a derivative left over from a previous profile. Coordinates are seconds.

matrix.Augment.name: Augment
matrix.Augment.label: Augment
matrix.Augment.description: NewAugment joins corresponding rows horizontally. Zip rejects unequal row counts, and the transpose round trips reject ragged input matrices.

matrix.Outer.name: Outer
matrix.Outer.label: Outer
matrix.Outer.description: NewOuter lifts two vector-valued expressions to a column and a row.

hawkes.Integral.name: Integral
hawkes.Integral.label: Integral
hawkes.Integral.description: NewIntegral reduces a response over each event's [lower,upper] ages inside (origin,horizon]. Events predating origin retain their decayed contribution.

equation.Peak.name: Peak
equation.Peak.label: Peak
equation.Peak.description: NewPeak selects the first absolute maximum; an undefined ordinate remains explicit.

equation.PredictiveInflation.name: PredictiveInflation
equation.PredictiveInflation.label: Predictive Inflation
equation.PredictiveInflation.description: NewPredictiveInflation evaluates sqrt(1+1/count) on a moment record.

algo.SquareRootRLS.name: SquareRootRLS
algo.SquareRootRLS.label: Square Root RLS
algo.SquareRootRLS.description: NewSquareRootRLS predicts each {design,target} before training. A {design} query never trains on an earlier target. Only a successful update commits the four posterior fields; invalid input does not reset or partially train the model.

data.Readout.name: Readout
data.Readout.label: Readout
data.Readout.description: NewReadout composes credibility, corroboration and the usable raw value. supports/contradictions yield authority values already resolved by their own configured graphs. discrete supplies the caller's coordinate/ordinal policy. No receiver introspection, child type assertion or recursive raw-value helper is needed; a child may be another configured Readout composition.

hawkes.EventLikelihood.name: EventLikelihood
hawkes.EventLikelihood.label: Event Likelihood
hawkes.EventLikelihood.description: NewEventLikelihood evaluates event log intensities on (origin,horizon]. Responses retain per-event supports for the score composition. Captured history is replayed explicitly; this reference topology is O(N*N), not the optimized chronological excitation recurrence from the original package.

correlation.LeadLag.name: LeadLag
correlation.LeadLag.label: Lead Lag
correlation.LeadLag.description: NewLeadLag composes the supplied search policy around an opaque estimator. Resolution is the finer path's median spacing; span is min(path counts)-2. The profile output preserves every estimator record and its own support. x is seconds, spacing is nanoseconds. The winning nonzero lag is compared with contemporaneous dependence. Empty searches are explicit undefined records. The inherited search_scale is a policy quantity, not a calibrated p-value.

vector.Apply.name: Apply
vector.Apply.label: Apply
vector.Apply.description: NewApply aligns one incoming value with each configured operation and forwards the operation's complete output run. Zip checks cardinality; Fan invokes the selected endpoint. No new invocation mechanism is necessary. Operations retain their identity between runs, so each coordinate may own an independent recurrence. A multi-output endpoint remains multi-output.

hawkes.Score.name: Score
hawkes.Score.label: Score
hawkes.Score.description: NewScore sums a supplied per-event derivative on one target side. It consumes the previously computed responses, never the live event source.

learning.Pace.name: Pace
learning.Pace.label: Pace
learning.Pace.description: NewPace composes empirical prior-error rank with the source's bounded log alpha controller. config yields rest,lower,upper,gain,band,window. These are explicit configuration, not newly chosen tuning constants. The calibrator owns history, the retained connection owns log alpha, and Mix owns movement.

equation.ValidPair.name: ValidPair
equation.ValidPair.label: Valid Pair
equation.ValidPair.description: NewValidPair is the supplied prediction/actual domain: finite, nonzero values.

matrix.Vector.name: Vector
matrix.Vector.label: Vector
matrix.Vector.description: NewVector multiplies a matrix expression by a vector expression, retaining the vector result rather than a one-column matrix payload.

learning.BinaryTarget.name: BinaryTarget
learning.BinaryTarget.label: Binary Target
learning.BinaryTarget.description: NewBinaryTarget classifies an increase without inventing a new numeric rule.

equation.EvidenceShare.name: EvidenceShare
equation.EvidenceShare.label: Evidence Share
equation.EvidenceShare.description: NewEvidenceShare selects one member after normalization. The index is a configured source. An absent index reports a shape error, while zero total mass remains undefined; neither becomes an apparently observed zero share.

equation.Standardizer.name: Standardizer
equation.Standardizer.label: Standardizer
equation.Standardizer.description: NewStandardizer preserves the source's inclusive score, using moments after incorporation. It is deliberately distinct from NewCausalResidual.

vector.Sum.name: Sum
vector.Sum.label: Sum
vector.Sum.description: NewSum adds paired scalar streams and collects their vector.

hawkes.IntegralDerivative.name: IntegralDerivative
hawkes.IntegralDerivative.label: Integral Derivative
hawkes.IntegralDerivative.description: NewIntegralDerivative is the derivative of the integral-support numerator with respect to beta, retaining both boundary-age terms.

hawkes.Kernel.name: Kernel
hawkes.Kernel.label: Kernel
hawkes.Kernel.description: NewKernel is exp(-beta*age). Rate and age are Primitive expressions; no event, side, storage or observation-window policy belongs to the kernel.

learning.IdentityTarget.name: IdentityTarget
learning.IdentityTarget.label: Identity Target
learning.IdentityTarget.description: NewIdentityTarget selects the finite current value.

equation.Entropy.name: Entropy
equation.Entropy.label: Entropy
equation.Entropy.description: NewEntropy composes -sum(p*log(p)). The zero-mass contribution is its limiting value zero; negative inputs retain the logarithm's undefined-domain result.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

store.Pairs.name: Pairs
store.Pairs.label: Pairs
store.Pairs.description: NewPairs configures the Primitive whose run is paired.

equation.Product.name: Product
equation.Product.label: Product
equation.Product.description: NewProduct binds two expressions to one captured input run. Both operands are computations, not decoded values; the source is consumed only once.

equation.WeightedVariance.name: WeightedVariance
equation.WeightedVariance.label: Weighted Variance
equation.WeightedVariance.description: NewWeightedVariance is E_w[x^2]-E_w[x]^2 over {weight,value} records. It is population dispersion, not an unbiased sample-variance correction. The nonnegative floor preserves the source cohort's roundoff convention; NaN remains undefined. There is no second accumulation implementation.

correlation.Path.name: Path
correlation.Path.label: Path
correlation.Path.description: NewPath retains timestamped observations. Equal timestamps restate the last observation; regressions return accepted=false without editing the path. Optional collection-to-collection retention remains caller-configured. Output records and their observation slices remain immutable across later updates.

inputs.name: retention
inputs.description: Streams this primitive reads, any number of them

causal.Counterfactual.name: Counterfactual
causal.Counterfactual.label: Counterfactual
causal.Counterfactual.description: NewCounterfactual composes abduction, intervention and prediction, preserving the factual residual as in the supplied table. fit and the two prediction connections may be arbitrary compatible graphs. Precision is the source's reconstruction audit weight 1/(1+abs(noise)), not a causal probability.

arithmetic.Product.name: Product
arithmetic.Product.label: Product
arithmetic.Product.description: NewProduct configures the value held before anything has been shown.

equation.EvidenceAuthority.name: EvidenceAuthority
equation.EvidenceAuthority.label: Evidence Authority
equation.EvidenceAuthority.description: NewEvidenceAuthority is the supplied measurement's maturity/SNR weighting. Unknown-SNR and zero-SNR factors are configuration, not new statistical laws.

matrix.Column.name: Column
matrix.Column.label: Column
matrix.Column.description: NewColumn arranges a scalar run as an n-by-one matrix.

probability.Calibrator.name: Calibrator
probability.Calibrator.label: Calibrator
probability.Calibrator.description: NewCalibrator scores against retained prior errors before appending a sample. Retention is a configured collection transform: identity for all history, Tail for a bounded history, or another composed selection policy.

hawkes.IntegralSupport.name: IntegralSupport
hawkes.IntegralSupport.label: Integral Support
hawkes.IntegralSupport.description: NewIntegralSupport composes the exponential compensator numerator per side. Divide by beta in the compensator, not here: this matches the source units.

learning.RLS.name: RLS
learning.RLS.label: RLS
learning.RLS.description: NewRLS supplies an affine intercept and the zero-mean diagonal coefficient prior. All configuration remains Primitive-valued and is evaluated at delivery time. Prediction is prior to the optional target's update, as owned by SquareRootRLS.

learning.RLSSum.name: RLSSum
learning.RLSSum.label: RLS Sum
learning.RLSSum.description: NewRLSSum predicts a sum of future feature rows from a retained posterior. Shared coefficient covariance is evaluated on the summed design; independent observation noise is counted once per row. The posterior connection is never trained or replaced by this query.

equation.LogReturns.name: LogReturns
equation.LogReturns.label: Log Returns
equation.LogReturns.description: NewLogReturns emits the existing {from,to,value} records from typed differences. The adjacent-pair width is two observations; it is not a retained time horizon.

rls.Prediction.name: Prediction
rls.Prediction.label: Prediction
rls.Prediction.description: NewPrediction forecasts from the supplied posterior before any model update.

vector.Scale.name: Scale
vector.Scale.label: Scale
vector.Scale.description: NewScale evaluates the vector and scalar once, then maps multiplication. The vector expression yields a []float64 payload; scale yields one scalar.

data.Authority.name: Authority
data.Authority.label: Authority
data.Authority.description: NewAuthority preserves the source measurement's policy factors: .5 for an estimated reading with unknown SNR, .1 for defined non-positive SNR. They are retained compatibility policy, not calibrated probabilities.

equation.RenewalRate.name: RenewalRate
equation.RenewalRate.label: Renewal Rate
equation.RenewalRate.description: NewRenewalRate accumulates quantity until a configured target is reached and positive time has elapsed. Input records contain increment and sample (float64) and at (int64 nanoseconds). The target receives each increment and owns its estimation policy. It must yield a positive quantity; no window is selected here. Each observation yields a record. closed distinguishes a completed span from a retained prior rate. The first completed span has no prior sample for change.

rls.Update.name: Update
rls.Update.label: Update
rls.Update.description: NewUpdate returns fresh posterior arrays and preserves the prior predictive facts.

linear.LocalRegression.name: LocalRegression
linear.LocalRegression.label: Local Regression
linear.LocalRegression.description: NewLocalRegression uses elapsed seconds from an exact int64 nanosecond origin as x and the observed value as y. The first origin is retained. Like the supplied implementation, this is cumulative; its old horizon argument never restricted evidence and no new retention policy is silently added.

linear.RegressionMoments.name: RegressionMoments
linear.RegressionMoments.label: Regression Moments
linear.RegressionMoments.description: NewRegressionMoments retains the five normal-equation sums and count of scalar (x,y) observations. It owns no regression solver or admission window; arithmetic performs each update and the configured KV feedback retains it.

equation.Elapsed.name: Elapsed
equation.Elapsed.label: Elapsed
equation.Elapsed.description: NewElapsed subtracts int64 nanoseconds before conversion to seconds. In particular, epoch magnitude cannot erase a small interval by cancellation.

equation.Mix.name: Mix
equation.Mix.label: Mix
equation.Mix.description: NewMix is left + weight*(right-left). Weight is data supplied in the record, not a mode on arithmetic. Zero preserves left; one selects right.

causal.Backdoor.name: Backdoor
causal.Backdoor.label: Backdoor
causal.Backdoor.description: NewBackdoor standardizes configured predictions over the observed rows after replacing the treatment coordinate. Fitting and predicting are Primitive connections, not a linear/nonlinear switch. The result is a model-dependent interventional estimate, not a claim that observational data identifies cause.

equation.Threshold.name: Threshold
equation.Threshold.label: Threshold
equation.Threshold.description: NewThreshold multiplies dispersion by a configured coefficient expression. The source's no-dispersion threshold of one is explicit at this level.

linear.SpectralRadius2.name: SpectralRadius2
linear.SpectralRadius2.label: Spectral Radius2
linear.SpectralRadius2.description: NewSpectralRadius2 composes the quadratic roots of a 2-by-2 matrix. For a complex-conjugate pair the common modulus is sqrt(det); otherwise the largest absolute real root is selected. Input entries are a,b,c,d.

learning.TrustWeight.name: TrustWeight
learning.TrustWeight.label: Trust Weight
learning.TrustWeight.description: NewTrustWeight composes the source's residual-range trust update. No clipping is added to the trust recurrence; rate greater than one retains the original extrapolating behavior. Invalid inputs fail before entering retained state.

equation.Argmax.name: Argmax
equation.Argmax.label: Argmax
equation.Argmax.description: NewArgmax preserves a winning value's ordinal through comparison and selection. Strict comparison keeps the first equal maximum. No hidden profile engine.

equation.Difference.name: Difference
equation.Difference.label: Difference
equation.Difference.description: NewDifference binds two expressions to one captured input run. Both operands are computations, not decoded values; the source is consumed only once.

equation.Energy.name: Energy
equation.Energy.label: Energy
equation.Energy.description: NewEnergy composes the sum of squared incoming scalar values.

equation.Maximum.name: Maximum
equation.Maximum.label: Maximum
equation.Maximum.description: NewMaximum binds both expressions to one captured input. The calculus fold owns the comparison and IEEE behavior; no finite sentinel substitutes for infinity.

matrix.Product.name: Product
matrix.Product.label: Product
matrix.Product.description: NewProduct pairs the configured matrix expressions before multiplying them.

algo.GaussJordan.name: GaussJordan
algo.GaussJordan.label: Gauss Jordan
algo.GaussJordan.description: NewGaussJordan composes partial-pivot Gauss-Jordan elimination. Input is a record containing left (square [][]float64) and right (n-by-q [][]float64). The tolerance expression supplies an absolute pivot floor. A singular solve yields defined=false and no solution, not regularization or guessed values. Numeric work belongs to dot/scale/difference compositions; this constructor owns only their ordering and feedback. It never operates on Go matrices.

prior.Memory.name: Memory
prior.Memory.label: Memory
prior.Memory.description: NewMemory supplies only the sufficient statistics, without transition scratch.

equation.LogMomentView.name: LogMomentView
equation.LogMomentView.label: Log Moment View
equation.LogMomentView.description: NewLogMomentView reads a log-space Welford record against prior moments. It does not log the input again. Noise and zscore follow the original joint estimator's minimum prior support and positive-dispersion requirements.

equation.Normalize.name: Normalize
equation.Normalize.label: Normalize
equation.Normalize.description: NewNormalize captures the total once and divides each original value by it. Zero totals remain mathematically undefined, not a fabricated distribution.

equation.Sum.name: Sum
equation.Sum.label: Sum
equation.Sum.description: NewSum binds two expressions to one captured input run. Both operands are computations, not decoded values; the source is consumed only once.
